Derive a family's structure from its density

Source: R/families.R
dot-classify.Rd

Everything that can be read off formals() plus the correction tables, and nothing that needs the data. Shared by fam() and families(), so that listing families does not mean catching errors from constructing them.

Usage

.classify(dist, fixed = NULL)

Value

NULL if no such density; otherwise a list with the modelled parameters, their links, dropped (derived) arguments, the fixed arguments and which of them the user must still supply, and default starts.
